message.content: {"rules":["The closure f registered with before_exec must perform only async-signal-safe operations when run in the child process after fork and before exec.","The caller must ensure that f does not violate library invariants by invalidly using resources duplicated by fork, including file descriptors and memory-mapped regions.","Panicking in f is safe only if all format arguments for the panic message can be safely formatted.","The closure f is permitted to return an I/O error."]}
